adapter.description: The adapter that took the print set (`lp`, `viewer`), or `file` when `--out` wrote it.

notices.description: The notices, in page order: each page printed at 100 % and clipped to a smaller paper.

out.description: The file written (`--out`) or opened in the viewer; `null` when spooled.

pages.description: The folio labels printed, in page order.

printer.description: The printer named with `--printer`; empty for the default printer or the viewer's choice.

scale.description: The smallest scale of a page in whole percent, rounded half up (100 when no page is scaled).
